node.statement: Defect estimate: writing eta=||U-U^dagger||, the product-norm axiom in def-epsilon-cstar-algebra, ||A||<=||U||<2, epsilon<=1/2, and U^dagger bold-dot U=J imply ||A bold-dot A-J||<=(1+epsilon)*(eta/2)*(||A||+||U||)<=3*eta. Hence ||P bold-dot P-P||=||Q bold-dot Q-Q||<=3*C_fix*epsilon/4<=C_fix*epsilon<=C_bridge*epsilon.
